title: Aspire Gotek X & Bar Salts Bundle Offer
description: VaThe Aspire Gotek X Kit is one of Aspire’s most popular pod kits, offering an unbeatable combination of portability and performance. With our exclusive Limited Bundle deal, you can now enjoy the Gotek X with Three 10ml bottles of Vampire Vape Bar Salts Nic Salt E-liquids, offering an unmatched vaping experience. Choose from an extensive selection of mouth-watering Bar Salts flavours and enjoy a seamless and flavoursome MTL (mouth-to-lung) or RDTL (restricted-direct-to-lung) vape with the innovative Aspire Gotek X. The 2ml refillable pod in the Gotek X Kit delivers up to 600 puffs of superb flavour, thanks to its 0.8ohm fixed mesh coil and side-filling design. When paired with Vampire Vape's Bar Salts, celebrated for their rich flavours, silky smooth throat hit and near-instant nicotine satisfaction, you'll enjoy an outstanding vaping experience for a fraction of the cost. Whether you're just transitioning from smoking to vaping or simply looking for an efficient and rewarding pod kit, our exclusive Aspire Gotek X bundled with Vampire Vape Bar Salts offers an unbeatable combination of performance, variety, and convenience. Please Note: This kit will require a USB Charging Cable. You can purchase a USB-C Charging Cable here. Customize Your Bundle the way you want, choose your favourite colour kit then select your 3 E-Liquids Kit Colour: Translucent Amber, Translucent Green, Translucent Yellow, Translucent Pink, Translucent Orange Bar Salts E-Liquid Flavours: Select 3 10ml, 10mg Bar Salts E-liquid from 18 mouth-watering flavours Please note: in rare instances, charging your Gotek X device with the pod attached may temporarily result in a diminished or burnt taste. For this reason we recommend charging your device with the pods removed, then reattach them once the device is fully charged.
